sentences.text: The Auditor General of Canada published a performance audit of Sustainable Development Technology Canada in the 2024 Spring Reports.
The audit identified ninety conflict-of-interest cases in the foundation's project approval files for the period under review.
The audit also identified deficiencies in the foundation's documentation of due diligence for project approvals.
The dataset records federal contributions totalling $134M to Sustainable Development Technology Canada between fiscal 2017 and fiscal 2024.
The records show thirty-one amendments to the underlying contribution agreement over that period.
The Departmental Results Report for Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada for fiscal 2023–24 references the foundation under the program category for clean technology.
The Government of Canada announced in June 2024 that the foundation's programming would be transitioned to the National Research Council.
Public records indicate the transition was completed during fiscal year 2024–25.
